heading: 神奇的捕食面罩
caption:
我的下唇平时折在嘴下，
像一张收起来的小面罩。
发现猎物，它迅速伸出去，
抓住食物，再收回来。
prompt:

Match the user's illustrated cicada reference: HAND-PAINTED naturalistic watercolor and gouache, visible fine pencil contours, luminous translucent washes, gentle dry-brush texture and cream paper grain, delicate realistic animal anatomy, sun-dappled leaves and calm nature. Main animal action below or alongside text occupying about 60% of image. Use only supplied text, do not add English, logos, labels, watermarks, arbitrary facts or speech bubbles.
